mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_cluster WHERE id>#{afterId} AND cluster_status IN ('ACTIVE','MITIGATING','REOPENED','RESOLVED') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id FROM t_cluster WHERE id IN #{id} AND cluster_status IN ('ACTIVE','MITIGATING','REOPENED','RESOLVED') AND (cluster_name_key IS NULL OR cluster_name IN ('一条反馈包含多个独立问题，需拆分后归簇','问题现象待归纳') OR canonical_symptom IN ('一条反馈包含多个独立问题，需拆分后归簇','问题现象待归纳')) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_cluster SET cluster_status='ARCHIVED',status_reason=CASE id WHEN #{row.id} THEN #{row.reason} ELSE status_reason END, status_changed_by=CASE id WHEN #{row.id} THEN IF(#{row.updateActor},#{row.userId},status_changed_by) ELSE status_changed_by END, status_changed_at=NOW(3),lifecycle_version=lifecycle_version+1, total_record_count=CASE id WHEN #{row.id} THEN IF(#{row.clearStatistics},0,total_record_count) ELSE total_record_count END, channel_distribution=CASE id WHEN #{row.id} THEN IF(#{row.clearStatistics},JSON_OBJECT(),channel_distribution) ELSE channel_distribution END, search_index_status='PENDING',vector_index_status='PENDING',updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id IN #{row.id} AND ((id=#{row.id} AND (#{row.onlyOperational}=FALSE OR cluster_status IN ('ACTIVE','MITIGATING','REOPENED','RESOLVED'))))

UPDATE t_cluster SET cluster_status=CASE id WHEN #{row.clusterId} THEN #{row.originalStatus} ELSE cluster_status END, status_reason=CASE id WHEN #{row.clusterId} THEN #{row.originalStatusReason} ELSE status_reason END, status_changed_by=CASE id WHEN #{row.clusterId} THEN #{row.originalStatusChangedBy} ELSE status_changed_by END, status_changed_at=CASE id WHEN #{row.clusterId} THEN #{row.originalStatusChangedAt} ELSE status_changed_at END, lifecycle_version=CASE id WHEN #{row.clusterId} THEN #{row.originalLifecycleVersion} ELSE lifecycle_version END WHERE id IN #{row.clusterId} AND ((id=#{row.clusterId} AND (cluster_status='ARCHIVED' OR cluster_status<>#{row.originalStatus})))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT cluster_name_key FROM t_cluster WHERE cluster_status IN ('ACTIVE','MITIGATING','REOPENED','RESOLVED') GROUP BY cluster_name_key HAVING COUNT(*)>1) duplicate_names

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_cluster WHERE cluster_status IN ('ACTIVE','MITIGATING','REOPENED','RESOLVED') AND (cluster_name_key IS NULL OR cluster_name IN ('一条反馈包含多个独立问题，需拆分后归簇','问题现象待归纳') OR canonical_symptom IN ('一条反馈包含多个独立问题，需拆分后归簇','问题现象待归纳'))
